title: Bounce Back
author: Frank Force
license_scope: The upstream repository LICENSE covers the source, tile sprite and screenshot retained here.
host_adaptations: Runs in a sandboxed opaque-origin iframe with a restrictive CSP; same-origin, network, form, and parent-page access are unavailable.
Excludes gameEngineDebug.js from execution because it contains an eval-based debug console.
Adds an explicit animation-loop pause/resume hook and a validated parent message channel.
Adds touch movement and aiming, standard gamepad movement/aiming, sound controls, and a bounded namespaced save bridge.
Preserves the pinned upstream files byte-for-byte under upstream/; scripts/build-bounceback.mjs verifies hashes before producing runtime derivatives.
device_evidence: Chromium automation is recorded separately; physical phones, controllers and Tesla browsers remain unverified.
